unit.why: Report of R. Zvi's sayings that the Besht and he himself would not descend to this world until promised sixty 'heroes' (disciples), and that his nephew of Zhidachov is one of them; no narrated event beyond the statements.
unit.boundary_note: trailing 'ט' is a catchword/stub; part of a numbered series of sayings (יח–כ) from the same source
